records.text: Erika Kirk's paternal grandfather Carl Kenneth Frantzve participated in horse racing and was an executive at the American Bank Note Company, which printed lottery tickets.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Carl Kenneth Frantzve is Erica (Erika Kirk)'s... ... paternal grandfather. ... He participated extensively in horse racing. More crucially though, he was an executive at the American Banknote Company in Illinois. ... This is the company that was responsible for printing lottery tickets.

verification.notes: Carl F. Frantzve is independently documented as Kent Frantzve's father and therefore Erika's paternal grandfather, and secondary reporting connects him to American Bank Note Company. The more specific horse-racing, lottery-ticket, and first-electronic-machine details were not all independently established, and the displayed caption may conflate Carl with Kent.
